norm: Original assembled FP64 A and returned x: unpreconditioned Euclidean norm of b-Ax in original variables.
denominator: Original RHS Euclidean norm, including for a nonzero KSP initial guess. A zero RHS uses the absolute tolerance alone.
nonlinear: Unchanged case solver tolerances, accepted field/constraint checks, positive KSP and SNES reasons, complete fixed-step history and all expected outputs.
reference: Audit both independent algorithms on identical original equations/window; compare complete fields/history and frozen physical checks. Self comparison is regression only.
status: predeclared candidates; eligibility is specific to a verified case, window and profile
physical: FSI_SVFSI_BENCHMARK.md; retain external inlet, outlet, mass, pressure, interface, area and RCR gates. Internal cross-tolerance differences use budgets below.
full_field_norms: Unweighted nodal RMS of vector difference lengths and maximum vector difference length, on every saved phase in each active domain.

pressure.basis: 10% of the 8% pressure-drop budget, also applied pointwise

flow.basis: 10% of the 5% outlet-flow budget on quarter-domain peak flow

fluid_velocity.basis: Peak Poiseuille centerline speed; same fractional allowance as flow

wall_velocity.basis: Harmonic velocity scale from radial displacement at 1 Hz

area.basis: Quarter cylindrical interface area times Lame strain

volume.basis: Quarter cylinder volume times Lame strain

jacobian.basis: Dimensionless change scaled by Lame area strain

power.basis: Wall force times harmonic wall speed
